text:
alex: quick runtime surge standup — status update + owners. Canary scheduled 08:30 PT tomorrow. Kernel micro-op landed in staging but we saw a 6% P99 regression in the long-context bench. need owners and immediate followups.

mira: taking kernel micro-op investigation. preliminary suspicion: kernel loop unrolled change + L1 pressure on 80k seqs. will bisect today.

sam: continuous-batching PR is in draft: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/487. Batching logic changes are behind a feature flag `continuous_batch_v2`. perf locally looks +15% throughput for short sequences, no regressions in short seq p99.

cheng: @sam can you add a smoke job to the canary pipeline that runs the 80k-seq bench? we should gate the canary on both short and long seqs.

sam: yes, will add a small job. command I plan to run: ```bazel run //runtime/perf:bench -- --model=redwood-13b --seq=81920 --runs=3```

alex: ownership: kernel micro-op = mira, batch rollout + smoke = sam, kv-cache warmup heuristics = cheng. if anyone needs to reassign ping here.

mira: quick Q about the kernel patch: should I keep the previous fast-path for older GPUs? i.e., fallback if architecture < sm_80.

cheng: keep the fallback for now. ops team reported some older infra still in Dedicated pools. fallback reduces blast radius. we can remove after next infra refresh.

sam: FYI I tagged @cheng on the PR for the smoke job. also added a small synthetic trace we can use to validate KV cache hits: ```trace: prefix=chat:conv_id, tokens=avg(3.2)```

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: runtime-canary-2026-04-01-0830. Stages: (1) smoke short-seq, (2) smoke long-seq, (3) roll 10% traffic for 15m, (4) monitor token latency & error rate. See pipeline: https://ci.internal/pipelines/runtime-canary-2026-04-01

alex: blockers: 1) mira to confirm regression root cause, 2) sam to add canary smoke for long seq, 3) cheng to verify kv warmup safe config for canary. If all green we go ahead with canary.

mira: started bisect — will post results in ~2 hours.

sam: smoke job created and queued. PR link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/487 (now includes canary job).

cheng: kv warmup config: setting `kv_warmup_threshold=64` and `kv_prefetch_batch=128` for canary. I'll push the config as a canary override.

alex: thanks all. small ask: reviewers, if you can glance at the two PRs (kernel micro-op and batching PR) today we'll aim for an evening merge window with a staged canary tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

mira: noted, adding perf artifacts to PR.

sam: will request review from @cheng and @mira in 10m.

cheng: will review after standup. if I spot issues I'll comment inline.

alex: last note — please paste any suspicious flamegraphs or pprof links here rather than DMing so we have context in thread. thanks.
